description: Verify that DUT responds to each Method Request in a quick burst
approach:
[Objective]
Burst handling: a back-to-back batch of Requests must each get a Response — no single drop, no rate-limit silently swallowing requests.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DUT → Tester: OfferService.
2. Tester → DUT: burst of N Method Requests in quick succession.
3. Observation: DUT → Tester: matching N Responses.

[Pass condition]
Observed DUT behaviour matches the spec property.

[Fail condition]
Per-phase Fail_phase<n>_* per the verdict list.

verdicts.Pass: DUT responded to every burst request — normal
verdicts.Fail_phase2_burst_response_missing: DUT did not respond to every request in burst
